title: A Gordon--Green-type result for Gorenstein-projective modules
summary: Let \(Λ\) be a \(\Z\)-graded Artin algebra which is Iwanaga--Gorenstein. We prove that \(Λ\) is CM-finite if and only if the category of gradable Gorenstein-projective modules has finite type, and if and only if the lengths of the indecomposable gradable Gorenstein-projective modules are bounded. Moreover, if \(Λ\) is CM-finite, then every Gorenstein-projective \(Λ\)-module is gradable. These results provide Gorenstein-projective analogues of the corresponding theorems of Gordon--Green for graded Artin algebras of finite representation type.
